queries.name: Daftar Invoice Belum Lunas
queries.purpose: Menampilkan daftar invoice penjualan yang masih memiliki outstanding beserta customer, jatuh tempo, umur piutang, dan aging bucket.
queries.query: SELECT si.siid AS invoice_id, si.sinotransaksi AS nomor_invoice, si.sitgl AS tanggal_invoice, si.sitgljatuhtempo AS tanggal_jatuh_tempo, c.kkode AS kode_customer, c.knama AS nama_customer, si.simatauang AS mata_uang, si.sitotaltransaksi AS total_invoice, si.sijmlbayar AS total_terbayar, (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) AS outstanding, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) AS aging_days, CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN 'Tanpa Jatuh Tempo' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) <= 0 THEN 'Belum Jatuh Tempo' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30 Hari' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60 Hari' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN '61-90 Hari' ELSE '>90 Hari' END AS aging_bucket, si.sistatuslunas AS status_lunas FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND ((si.sistatuslunas IS NULL OR si.sistatuslunas <> 'LUNAS') OR (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0) AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0 ORDER BY aging_days DESC, outstanding DESC

queries.name: Outstanding dan Risiko per Customer
queries.purpose: Merangkum total outstanding per customer sekaligus memberi ranking customer dengan risiko keterlambatan tertinggi.
queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.kkode AS kode_customer, c.knama AS nama_customer, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice_terbuka, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) AS total_outstanding, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) > 0 THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding_overdue, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jumlah_invoice_overdue, MAX(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) ELSE NULL END) AS maksimum_hari_terlambat FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND ((si.sistatuslunas IS NULL OR si.sistatuslunas <> 'LUNAS') OR (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0) AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0 GROUP BY c.kid, c.kkode, c.knama ORDER BY outstanding_overdue DESC, maksimum_hari_terlambat DESC, total_outstanding DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Distribusi Aging Bucket
queries.purpose: Menampilkan distribusi outstanding piutang berdasarkan kelompok umur piutang.
queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN 'Tanpa Jatuh Tempo' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) <= 0 THEN 'Belum Jatuh Tempo' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30 Hari' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60 Hari' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN '61-90 Hari' ELSE '>90 Hari' END AS aging_bucket, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) AS total_outstanding FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND ((si.sistatuslunas IS NULL OR si.sistatuslunas <> 'LUNAS') OR (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0) AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - si.sijmlbayar) > 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN 'Tanpa Jatuh Tempo' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) <= 0 THEN 'Belum Jatuh Tempo' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30 Hari' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60 Hari' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN '61-90 Hari' ELSE '>90 Hari' END ORDER BY CASE aging_bucket WHEN 'Tanpa Jatuh Tempo' THEN 1 WHEN 'Belum Jatuh Tempo' THEN 2 WHEN '1-30 Hari' THEN 3 WHEN '31-60 Hari' THEN 4 WHEN '61-90 Hari' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

queries.name: Monthly Funnel Summary
queries.purpose: Ringkasan funnel bulanan dari SQ ke SO, DO, DR, dan SI berdasarkan cohort bulan SQ.
queries.query:
SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(sq.sqtgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sq.sqid) AS jumlah_sq,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so.soid) AS jumlah_so,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dox.doid) AS jumlah_do,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dr.drid) AS jumlah_dr,
  COUNT(DISTINCT si.siid) AS jumlah_si
FROM m5_sq AS sq
LEFT JOIN m5_so AS so
  ON so.soidsq = sq.sqid
  AND so.soisclose = 0
LEFT JOIN m5_do AS dox
  ON dox.doidso = so.soid
  AND dox.doisclose = 0
LEFT JOIN m5_dr AS dr
  ON dr.driddo = dox.doid
LEFT JOIN m5_si AS si
  ON (si.siiddo = dox.doid OR si.siiddr = dr.drid)
  AND si.siisclose = 0
WHERE sq.sqisclose = 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sq.sqtgl, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY bulan ASC

queries.name: Monthly Conversion Rates
queries.purpose: Menghitung conversion rate bulanan dari SQ ke tiap tahap dan antar tahap funnel.
queries.query:
SELECT
  x.bulan,
  x.jumlah_sq,
  x.jumlah_so,
  x.jumlah_do,
  x.jumlah_dr,
  x.jumlah_si,
  ROUND((x.jumlah_so / NULLIF(x.jumlah_sq, 0)) * 100, 2) AS conversion_sq_ke_so_pct,
  ROUND((x.jumlah_do / NULLIF(x.jumlah_so, 0)) * 100, 2) AS conversion_so_ke_do_pct,
  ROUND((x.jumlah_dr / NULLIF(x.jumlah_do, 0)) * 100, 2) AS conversion_do_ke_dr_pct,
  ROUND((x.jumlah_si / NULLIF(x.jumlah_dr, 0)) * 100, 2) AS conversion_dr_ke_si_pct,
  ROUND((x.jumlah_si / NULLIF(x.jumlah_sq, 0)) * 100, 2) AS conversion_sq_ke_si_pct
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(sq.sqtgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sq.sqid) AS jumlah_sq,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.soid) AS jumlah_so,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dox.doid) AS jumlah_do,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dr.drid) AS jumlah_dr,
    COUNT(DISTINCT si.siid) AS jumlah_si
  FROM m5_sq AS sq
  LEFT JOIN m5_so AS so
    ON so.soidsq = sq.sqid
    AND so.soisclose = 0
  LEFT JOIN m5_do AS dox
    ON dox.doidso = so.soid
    AND dox.doisclose = 0
  LEFT JOIN m5_dr AS dr
    ON dr.driddo = dox.doid
  LEFT JOIN m5_si AS si
    ON (si.siiddo = dox.doid OR si.siiddr = dr.drid)
    AND si.siisclose = 0
  WHERE sq.sqisclose = 0
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sq.sqtgl, '%Y-%m')
) AS x
ORDER BY x.bulan ASC

queries.name: Monthly Stage Trend
queries.purpose: Tren bulanan jumlah dokumen per stage berdasarkan bulan dokumen masing-masing.
queries.query:
SELECT
  t.bulan,
  t.stage,
  t.jumlah_dokumen
FROM (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sq.sqtgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, 'SQ' AS stage, COUNT(DISTINCT sq.sqid) AS jumlah_dokumen
  FROM m5_sq AS sq
  WHERE sq.sqisclose = 0
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sq.sqtgl, '%Y-%m')

  UNION ALL

  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(so.sotgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, 'SO' AS stage, COUNT(DISTINCT so.soid) AS jumlah_dokumen
  FROM m5_so AS so
  WHERE so.soisclose = 0
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(so.sotgl, '%Y-%m')

  UNION ALL

  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(dox.dotgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, 'DO' AS stage, COUNT(DISTINCT dox.doid) AS jumlah_dokumen
  FROM m5_do AS dox
  WHERE dox.doisclose = 0
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(dox.dotgl, '%Y-%m')

  UNION ALL

  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(dr.drtgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, 'DR' AS stage, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.drid) AS jumlah_dokumen
  FROM m5_dr AS dr
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(dr.drtgl, '%Y-%m')

  UNION ALL

  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(si.sitgl, '%Y-%m') AS bulan, 'SI' AS stage, COUNT(DISTINCT si.siid) AS jumlah_dokumen
  FROM m5_si AS si
  WHERE si.siisclose = 0
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(si.sitgl, '%Y-%m')
) AS t
ORDER BY t.bulan ASC,
  CASE t.stage
    WHEN 'SQ' THEN 1
    WHEN 'SO' THEN 2
    WHEN 'DO' THEN 3
    WHEN 'DR' THEN 4
    WHEN 'SI' THEN 5
    ELSE 99
  END ASC

queries.purpose: Merangking customer berdasarkan skor risiko gabungan dari outstanding, aging, retur, collection lambat, dan fulfillment macet.

COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 THEN 1 END) AS invoice_count_open, SUM(CASE WHEN (COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 THEN (COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding_amount, MAX(CASE WHEN (COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 THEN GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE(si.sitgljatuhtempo, si.sitgl)), 0) ELSE 0 END) AS max_aging_days, AVG(CASE WHEN (COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 THEN GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE(si.sitgljatuhtempo, si.sitgl)), 0) END) AS avg_aging_days, COUNT(CASE WHEN si.sistatuslunas <> 'LUNAS' AND COALESCE(si.sitgljatuhtempo, si.sitgl) < CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS collection_delay_invoice_count FROM m5_si si WHERE si.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY si.sicustomer ) ar ON ar.sicustomer = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sr.srcustomer, COUNT(*) AS return_count, SUM(COALESCE(sr.srtotaltransaksi, 0)) AS return_amount FROM m5_sr sr GROUP BY sr.srcustomer ) rt ON rt.srcustomer = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT so.socustomer, COUNT(*) AS stalled_so_count, SUM(COALESCE(so.sototaltransaksi, 0)) AS stalled_so_value FROM m5_so so WHERE so.soisclose = 0 AND (COALESCE(so.sostatusrealisasi, '') NOT IN ('SELESAI', 'LUNAS', 'CLOSE', 'CLOSED')) AND COALESCE(so.sotglkirim, so.sotgl) < CURDATE() GROUP BY so.socustomer ) ff ON ff.socustomer = c.kid WHERE c.kaktif = 1 AND (COALESCE(ar.outstanding_amount, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(rt.return_amount, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(ff.stalled_so_count, 0) > 0) ORDER BY risk_score DESC, outstanding_amount DESC, max_aging_days DESC LIMIT 100

queries.query: SELECT month_period, SUM(invoice_outstanding_amount) AS invoice_outstanding_amount, SUM(return_amount) AS return_amount FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(si.sitgl, '%Y-%m') AS month_period, SUM(CASE WHEN (COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 THEN (COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) ELSE 0 END) AS invoice_outstanding_amount, 0 AS return_amount FROM m5_si si WHERE si.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(si.sitgl, '%Y-%m') UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sr.srtgl, '%Y-%m') AS month_period, 0 AS invoice_outstanding_amount, SUM(COALESCE(sr.srtotaltransaksi, 0)) AS return_amount FROM m5_sr sr GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sr.srtgl, '%Y-%m') ) t GROUP BY month_period ORDER BY month_period
